I received carrier confirmation this morning that a shipment of four tires specifically for V-14 is scheduled to arrive at the motor pool by 1600 tomorrow. This revised delivery is not yet reflected in the battalion supply tracker. Given that we currently have only eight serviceable tires on hand—enough for two vehicles—I recommend we defer V-14 until that shipment arrives rather than consuming tires from current stock. This would allow us to use the eight tires on hand for V-11 and V-19, and then service V-14 once its dedicated tire shipment arrives tomorrow afternoon.
